svg.title: What killed each tier 5
svg.desc: For each tier 5 alone from wave 1, the share of lost lives put down to Veiled, flyers, armour, shields, healers, hulks, bosses or sheer numbers.
svg.text: What their lives were lost to, alone from wave 1 (share of all 150 lives)
Each lost life goes to the first that fits: boss, Veiled it can't see, flyer it can't hit, shielded, healed, armoured against its damage, hulk, otherwise sheer numbers (grey).
